    r = (min([p[0] for p in b]) + max([p[0] for p in b])) // 2

print(f"\nAfter clicking (19,30): G={len(G_nodes)}, g={len(g_nodes2)}, N={len(N_nodes)}")

# Check what changed
if last_transition:
    before_seg = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation
    after_seg = last_transition.after_frame.segmentation
    before_colors = set(n['color'] for n in before_seg['nodes'])
    after_colors = set(n['color'] for n in after_seg['nodes'])
    print(f"New colors: {after_colors - before_colors}")
    print(f"Lost colors: {before_colors - after_colors}")
</parameter>
</function>
